title: 陰XOR陽
author: nahiko
facts: the XOR result as one boolean
description: Three neurons in two layers compute XOR. The artist minted this work in August 2021 as a one-token NFT. The artist and the collector each set one input. The network turns the two inputs into yin, yang, or a blend. The weights are fixed values in the contract; anyone can read them. isYingYang() runs the model fully inside Ethereum.

call.note: isYingYang() — runs the model on the two stored inputs and returns the XOR output as a bool
